The plate is a paper plate about 260 px across, which at roughly 20 cm works out to about 13 px per cm. I count 10 grapes, each about 40 px long (about 3 cm) and 30 px wide (about 2.3 cm). That is large for a grape, so a weight of about 6 g each is reasonable.

Ten grapes at roughly 6 g each comes to about 60 g.
